mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.scene_id, s.name AS scene_name, c.title, c.created_time, c.updated_time FROM ai_conversation c LEFT JOIN ai_scene s ON c.scene_id = s.id WHERE c.id = #{id} AND c.deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM ai_conversation WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_conversation (user_id, scene_id, title, deleted, created_time, updated_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{sceneId}, #{title}, 0, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_conversation SET deleted = 1, updated_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE ai_conversation SET title = #{title}, updated_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
